questions.question: What is the torque specification for the main coupling bolt?
Where is valve V-101 located in the P&ID diagram?
questions.answer: Section A-3, upstream of pump P-102

questions.question: What are the operating voltage requirements for relay S1?
List the safety warnings for high-pressure testing procedures
questions.answer: 1) Wear safety goggles, 2) Ensure pressure relief valve operational, 3) Maximum test pressure 150 PSI, 4) Evacuate area during test

questions.question: What changed in the wiring configuration between Rev B and Rev C?
questions.answer: Relay K2 was added to the control circuit, relay S1 now routes through K2 instead of direct connection
